_notes: Streaming Shuffle Grafana dashboard template. Panel expressions match Spark's PrometheusServlet metric naming convention: 'metrics_<app-id>_<executor-id>_<source-name>_<metric-key>_<Suffix>{type="<group>"}' where <metric-key> for streaming shuffle is 'shuffle_streaming_<metric-name>' (the dots in the AAP-mandated 'shuffle.streaming.<metric-name>' key are normalized to underscores by PrometheusServlet.normalizeKey). Gauge metrics expose '_Number' and '_Value' suffixes; Counter metrics expose '_Count' suffix. The wildcard '.+' across the application and executor segments aggregates every executor's instance of the named metric. The dashboard intentionally omits a per-executor template variable selector because Spark's PrometheusServlet emits only {type="..."} labels (the executor identifier is encoded in the metric NAME, not a Prometheus label). Operators who require an 'executor' label (for filtering or grouping) MUST configure either: (a) a Prometheus relabel_config with a 'metric_relabel_configs' entry that extracts the executor segment from the metric name into a label, or (b) a JMX Exporter pattern rule that produces 'app_id' and 'executor' labels at the JMX-to-Prometheus conversion step. See blitzy-docs/streaming-shuffle/observability.md 'Dashboard Prerequisites' for concrete relabeling examples.
title: Streaming Shuffle

panels.title: Buffer Utilization Percent
panels.description: Per-executor streaming-shuffle buffer utilization (0-100). Sampled by MemorySpillManager at 100 ms intervals. Spill triggers at the configured spillThreshold (default 80%).

panels.title: Spill Count (cumulative)
panels.description: Cumulative count of spill events across all executors. Each event is emitted by MemorySpillManager when buffer utilization meets or exceeds spark.shuffle.streaming.spillThreshold.

panels.title: Backpressure Events (per minute)
panels.description: Rate of backpressure events emitted by BackpressureProtocol, summed across executors and rescaled to events-per-minute. Spikes correlate with rate-limit triggers, heartbeat misses, and priority arbitration events.

panels.title: Partial-Read Invalidations
panels.description: Cumulative count of producer-failure detections from StreamingShuffleReader triggering partial-read invalidation and FetchFailedException propagation. Any non-zero value indicates upstream-stage recomputation has been triggered at least once.
